edit.description: `Command::Guard` (~:350) reads the payload's `hook_event_name` and splits on it: `PreToolUse` (and a payload naming no event) keeps today's pending-write path unchanged; `PostToolUse` judges the tree the call left. The subcommand doc (~:124) opens "The `PreToolUse` guard" and must name both edges, as `distribution.md` now does. `serde_json` already parses a hook payload in `tap::record_from_payload` and the guard's own `extract_file_path` (install.rs:1015) is a regex — pick one of the two, never add a third reader.

The post edge's judge beside `guard` (~:960): the projection half of the root `fresh` clause — `drift::config_stale`, the same judge `check` runs at `gate.rs`, re-hashing each lock row's `source_path` against its `emit_hash` — rendered as findings at the mode `compose::mode_from_declarations` answers, silent when it finds none. `GATE_HOOKS`' `PostToolUse` row (~:221) runs `GUARD_COMMAND` (~:160), so `POST_TOOL_USE_COMMAND` (~:176) retires with it and `BASH_MATCHER`'s doc (~:166) stops naming `check`. The locus half is the blocked sibling, not this entry.

The `PostToolUse` envelope from the event-name parameter the parent entry lands: the rendered findings as `additionalContext` under `warn`, and `decision: "block"` with a `reason` naming the restore (`temper emit`) under `block` — the strongest in-band refusal this event offers, since a write already made cannot be denied. Cite the external fact at the site (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, "JSON output", retrieved 2026-09-24): a hook that stamps any name but the firing event's is rejected whole.

The guard's mode loop (~:545) drives `PreToolUse` payloads only. Add the shell edge over the same fixtures: a hand-edited projection under each of the three modes, and a clean tree at every mode printing nothing.

`:640` asserts the wired PostToolUse command is `temper::install::POST_TOOL_USE_COMMAND`; it reads `GUARD_COMMAND` once the row runs the guard. The placement assertions at `:1245` and `:1460` keep `Placement::PostToolUseHook` — the placement stays, only its command moves.

One `## [Unreleased]` entry: the PostToolUse gate row's command changes, so a harness scaffolded before this ships carries the old `temper check . --reporter session-start` line in `.claude/settings.json` and must re-run `temper install` (or, for a represented harness, change that one line in the hook module and re-emit). This is the upgrade block 0060's Consequences names.

summary: `temper guard` runs at both edges of a tool call: after a shell tool it judges projection drift against the tree the call left, in that event's own envelope, at the declared mode.

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

tests.asserts: a `PostToolUse` payload over a tree carrying a hand-edited projection surfaces the finding in-band under `warn`, refuses the call's result under `block`, and prints nothing under `note` — and a clean tree prints nothing at any mode
the `PostToolUse` gate row wires the same `temper guard .` command the `PreToolUse` row runs, and `gate_installed` reads it as installed

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the new shell-edge cases, which fail on the pre-fix tree (the guard ignores the event and the row still runs `check`); `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
notes: 0060 measured the live placement on 2.1.281: it stamps `hookEventName: "SessionStart"`, Claude Code rejects the output whole, and it has never carried a finding. Two human follow-ups ride this ship, both outside build's fence: `.temper/hooks.ts` mirrors POST_TOOL_USE_COMMAND by hand, and docs/cli.md's `guard` section still opens "A `PreToolUse` hook body". src/install.rs and tests/install.rs overlap fork-held INSTALL-LIFTS. scoped at a4086d03
